summary: M0 model-only verdict: CONTAIN @ 0.82. Account k.erdem@aegean.edu shows two concurrent access patterns. The legitimate user signs in from Manisa, Turkey (AS-AEGEAN-EDU, 193.140.10.9, device dev-ke-ws) during business hours across portal/mail/vpn. Separately, the same account is successfully accessed from 203.0.113.45 (DigitalOcean, Frankfurt, DE) every ~2 days at roughly 02:00 across portal, mail, and sis, with no device_id and mfa_prompt_count 0, persisting from October through 2026-11-07. This is impossible travel/concurrent sessions from a foreign cloud VPS with automated off-hours cadence and access to the sensitive SIS system, while the real user remains active — classic credential-based account takeover rather than a weak or explained signal. Evidence is sufficient to act (revoke sessions, force password reset, disable the anomalous access) rather than escalate for more evidence.
